metadata.title: When your aim clocks in late but still racks up 2 kills like a glitch
metadata.description:
My brain was AFK but the kills still hit.
Enemy probably uninstalling to question everything.
Valorant logic: handing out freebies with zero shame.
Click if your aim ghosts but the scoreboard disagrees!

Smash that like if your aim’s AFK but the kills still roll in!

#valorant #luckykills #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts
